title: CreateLegalDocument
description:
Input serializer for POST. Mirrors the submittable fields on the model plus
cross-field rules (BAA addon, DPA mode, uniqueness). The view supplies the
organization and submitting user.

company_name.description: The customer legal entity entering the agreement (PandaDoc's Client.Company).

representative_email.description: Email the signed PandaDoc envelope is sent to (PandaDoc's Client.Email).
